Population increased in Wirral

The estimated population of Wirral in 2024 was 328,873 usual residents, a rise of 1.0% since 2023.

This meant that Wirral's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Wirral increased by 2.6%.

Over this slightly longer period, Wirral was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Wirral

The average (median) age fell to 44 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Wirral has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Wirral is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Wirral's population of 328,873 usual residents was made up of:

  • 58,322 people aged 0 to 15 years, (17.7%)
  • 196,437 people aged 16 to 64 years, (59.7%)
  • 74,114 people aged 65 years and over, (22.5%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Wirral has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (22.5% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Wirral, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Wirral
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Wirral, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 1,170 people (-0.4%). In total, there were 2,755 births and 3,925 deaths in Wirral.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 2,446 (0.8%). There were 11,397 people entering the area and 8,951 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Wirral's population of 2,008 (0.6%) as a result of 2,766 people entering the area and 758 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Wirral was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Wirral in mid-2023 is 325,583.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 894 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 163 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 731 people.
